messages:
sara: Candidate build sha1234 created. Includes DB migration scripts v2.1 (online migration). Need pin on image, a short canary in eu-west-1, and run the preflight migration check before promoting to prod.

sara: Migration notes pasted below, small schema tweak + backfill that runs async. No downtime expected but we should keep rollback path ready.

sara: Release notes draft:
```
- Feature: faster prompt routing
- Ops: DB schema 2026_03_20_v2.1 (adds "prefetch_idx")
- Migration: online, adds index then backfills in background, idempotent
- Rollback: image rollback + run reverse migration script (safe no-drop)
```

mike: Putting pin request here. Which image tag should we pin to for dedicated pools?

sara: Pin to docker.redwood/infra:sha1234-prod-pin. I'll add it to the RC metadata.

anya: QA: we'll run the full smoke and regression on canary. Canary window 30m then extended if green. Any special test seeds for the new index?

sara: Good call. Use seed set: canary-db-checks.yml (contains a small workload to exercise reindex path). Also run embedder latency probe.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Preflight check queued for sha1234. Running DB migration dry-run on staging clone...

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Dry-run OK. No blocking issues found.

tim: Ops: the usual change window today is 22:00-02:00 UTC, but we have a marketplace partner deploy at 23:30. Can we start canary at 22:05 and avoid overlap?

ops-oncall: I'm okay with 22:05 start. I'll hold the oncall shift and watch rollout.

product: Quick ask: include short customer-facing blurb for release notes. I can draft if you want.

anya: QA ready for canary at 22:05. Will attach canary results in thread.

sara: Ok final checklist: pin image, preflight dry-run (done), canary eu-west-1 10% traffic for 30m, run regression suite, monitor errors and latency, then promote. Rollback command ready.

sara: Initiating canary now. Command:
```
deploy promote --candidate sha1234 --to canary --region eu-west-1 --pin-image docker.redwood/infra:sha1234-prod-pin --canary-duration 1800 --notify @ops-oncall,@anya
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started in eu-west-1 (10% traffic, 5 pods). Tracking metric group: app/requests, app/latency, db/migration-errors.

qa-bot: [qa-bot] Smoke tests running: 24 checks queued. No failures so far.

anya: Canary 10m update: regressions all pass, latency +5% within SLO, no DB errors.

mike: :thumbsup: If 30m passes green, I'm happy to sign off for prod pin.

sara: Can we hold final promotion until 22:50 to avoid partner burst? Then we'll promote to prod and keep a 15m watch.

ops-oncall: Agree. I'll keep the window quiet and escalate on any anomalies.

sara: Promoting to prod at 22:50. Final command (dry-run shown below):
```
# promote to prod, waits up to 10m for health checks
deploy promote --candidate sha1234 --to prod --pin-image docker.redwood/infra:sha1234-prod-pin --wait 600 --rollback-cmd "deploy rollback --to previous --run-reverse-migration"
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started. Shifting traffic gradually: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 12 minutes. Notifying: @ops-oncall, @anya, @mike, @product.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Health checks passing during ramp. No errors in app/requests. db/migration-errors: 0.

sara: Promo complete. All traffic on prod. Will keep the 15m watch, then close the RC and publish release notes.

product: Drafted customer blurb and will post after the 15m watch.

mike: Thanks all. Greatly appreciated.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion success. RC sha1234 -> prod tag docker.redwood/infra:sha1234-prod-pin. Rollback window open for 60m.

sara: Closing this thread. Filing post-deploy followups in #postmortems if needed. :party:
